scope: Source/topology classification of four remaining finite-road conflicts and millimetre generated-apron grade controls. This is not physical acceptance and does not authorize a whole-road bridge-family or no-clearance exemption.

cases.classification: Opposing nearly parallel untagged arterial carriageways attached to separate flyover approach roots; no local shared-connector path and no independent stacked-road source evidence. Null tags establish neither zero absolute altitude nor a surveyed stack. Generated differing approach datums must not be mistaken for genuine separation.

Opposing source-confirmed three-lane arterial carriageways attached to distinct Masab flyover approach roots. No local shared-connector permission, no bridge/layer/tunnel declaration on these ways, and no evidence of an independent vertical stack. Preserve all three lanes and real crossing headroom; resolve overlapping pavement with bounded geometry/profile coherence.

Ground-facing end of a partially positive bridge link beside the full-positive PV mainline. The local endpoint lies outside the link positive layer interval and connects to Inner Ring Road, while the shared positive flyover node is remote. A source-common bridge family must not impose co-height at this endpoint; preserve local independent surface clearance and source-compatible ramp transition.

Ground-facing start of a partially positive bridge link beside the full-positive PV mainline. The local endpoint lies outside the link positive layer interval and connects to Inner Ring Road, while the shared positive flyover node is remote. A source-common bridge family must not impose co-height at this endpoint; preserve local independent surface clearance and source-compatible ramp transition.

generatedInteriorControls.authority: No bridge/layer/tunnel/absolute surveyed elevation declaration. These generated estimated interior heights may be locally smoothed within the already approved bounded-apron policy, retaining actual finite crossing/rail/negative/profile bounds and source lane capacity.

limits: Source tags are relative order and capacity evidence, not metre altitude survey.
Near-parallel appearance and a remote shared network path do not create local source-apron permission.
Only exact positive source fractions may enter a same-bridge family constraint; unknown tails retain independent source-order/headroom evaluation.
Candidate centerline projections are diagnostic; actual emitted Float32 triangle, full vehicle, obstacle and final tile-seam tests remain required.
